title: Keep failed MCP initialization recoverable while preserving tool protocol errors
outcome: Keep failed MCP initialization recoverable while preserving tool protocol errors
acceptance: DispatchedRecoveryFailuresNeverReplayAndNextCallUsesAWorkingConnection(initialize-protocol-error) passes; initialization refusal is typed retryable and next call reconnects, unlike tool protocol errors which retain the live client.

completion.summary: Initialization rejection remains typed/retryable and a subsequent call initializes a fresh connection; tool protocol rejection preserves exact code and current client. Intermediate correction RED1/4 then broad188/188 and full1756/0/2; verified by original reviewers6510/6511.
